name: ramalama-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is RamaLama (`ramalama`), a command-line tool that runs and serves AI models in
containers. It loads its settings from layered `ramalama.conf` files and `RAMALAMA_*` environment variables, resolves
model references (shortnames, `hf://`, `ollama://`, `oci://`, `file://` and other transports) into its local model
store, builds the `podman`/`docker` command that runs llama.cpp, vLLM or MLX for `ramalama run` and `ramalama serve`,
and generates quadlet, Kubernetes and Compose service files.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
The implementation in scope is these modules of the `ramalama` package: ramalama/__init__.py, ramalama/amdkfd.py,
ramalama/annotations.py, ramalama/arg_types.py, ramalama/cli.py, ramalama/cli_arg_normalization.py,
ramalama/common.py, ramalama/compat.py, ramalama/compose.py, ramalama/config.py, ramalama/config_types.py,
ramalama/console.py, ramalama/endian.py, ramalama/engine.py, ramalama/file.py, ramalama/hf_style_repo_base.py,
ramalama/host_utils.py, ramalama/kube.py, ramalama/layered_config.py, ramalama/log_levels.py, ramalama/logger.py,
ramalama/oci_tools.py, ramalama/ollama_repo_utils.py, ramalama/path_utils.py, ramalama/prompt_utils.py,
ramalama/quadlet.py, ramalama/shortnames.py, ramalama/toml_parser.py, ramalama/version.py; every module under
ramalama/transports/ (including ramalama/transports/oci/); every module under ramalama/model_store/; and
ramalama/plugins/interface.py, ramalama/p
